source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of operator precedence (PDF 40-41).

blocks.text: Operator precedence (pehle kaun hoga, is ka rule) batati hai ke expression mein kaunsa operation pehle hoga. Python mein bhi, Mathematics (riyazi) ki tarah, kuch operators ki precedence zyada hai aur woh pehle hal hote hain. Yeh samajhna zaroori hai ta ke hisaab theek ho.

items: Parentheses (brackets) '( )': sab se zyada precedence; andar ka hisaab sab se pehle. (3 + 2) * 4 = 20.
Exponentiation (**, power): is ke baad. 2³, yani 2 ** 3 = 8.
Multiplication '*', division '/' aur modulus '%': phir yeh. 4*3 = 12, 10/2 = 5.0 aur 11%3 = 2.
Addition '+' aur subtraction '-': in ki precedence multiplication aur division se kam hai. 5 + 2 = 7 aur 10-4 = 6.
Misaal: 3 + 2*5 mein multiplication addition se pehle hogi: 3 + 2*5 = 3 + 10 = 13.

blocks.alt: Chaar khaanon ki seerhi: sab se oopar brackets ( ), phir power **, phir multiplication, division aur modulus * / %, aur sab se neeche addition aur subtraction + -. Baen taraf teer 'pehle' se 'baad mein' ki taraf. Neeche misalein: 3 + 2 * 5 -> 3 + 10 -> 13 aur (3 + 2) * 4 -> 5 * 4 -> 20.
blocks.caption: Operator precedence ki seerhi: jo oopar hai woh pehle hota hai (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
Neeche ki expressions hal karein aur results class fellows aur teacher se milayein.
1. 10 + 3*2 **2-5/5
2. (10 + 3) * (2 ** (2 - 1)) / 5
In ko Python syntax mein likhein (kitab mein fraction (kasar) ki lakeer beech mein chhapi hai):
1. 5 + 3 x4-7 2² +1
2. 10 x (2 + 3) - 4² 8 :  2 +5

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Kitab mein "translate" wali dono expressions ki fraction wali shakal chhapai mein bigar gayi hai, is liye un ka theek matlab pakka nahi. Pehli ko agar 5 + (3 x 4 - 7) / (2² + 1) parha jaye to Python mein 5 + (3 * 4 - 7) / (2 ** 2 + 1) likhenge, jis ka jawab 6.0 hai. Yaad rakhein: x ki jagah *, power ke liye ** aur fraction ke upar aur neeche wale hisson ko brackets mein rakhein.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Brackets laga kar lambi expressions saaf ho jati hain aur hisaab usi order (tarteeb) se hota hai jo aap chahte hain.

blocks.prompt: Operator precedence ki definition (matlab) bataiye aur aisi misal dijiye jahan yeh nateeja badle (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Yeh rule hai ke kaunsa operation pehle hoga. 2 + 3 * 4 ka jawab 14 hai kyunke * + se pehle hota hai, jabke (2 + 3) * 4 ka 20.
